Qasam hai un ki jo doob kar kheench lene waale hain
Aur aasaani se khol dene waale hain
Aur fiza mein pairne waale hain
Phir tez-raftaari se sabqat karne waale hain
Phir umoor ka intezaam karne waale hain
Jis din zameen ko jhatka diya jaaega
Aur us ke baad doosra jhatka lagega
Us din dil larz jaayenge
Aankhein khauf se jhuki hongi
Yeh kuffaar kehte hain ke kya hum palat kar phir is duniya mein bheje jaayenge
Kya jab hum khokhli haddiyaan ho jaayenge tab
Yeh to bade ghaate waali waapasi hogi
Yeh qiyaamat to bas ek cheekh hogi
Jis ke baad sab maidaan-e-mahshar mein nazar aayenge
Kya tumhaare paas Moosa ki khabar aayi hai
Jab un ke Rab ne unhein Tuwa ki muqaddas waadi mein aawaaz di
Fir'aun ki taraf jaao, woh sarkash ho gaya hai
Us se kaho kya yeh mumkin hai ke tu paakeeza kirdaar ho jaaye
Aur main tujhe tere Rab ki taraf hidaayat karoon aur tere dil mein khauf paida ho jaaye
Phir unhon ne use azeem nishaani dikhlaayi
To us ne inkaar kar diya aur naafarmaani ki
Phir munh pher kar daud-dhoop mein lag gaya
Phir sab ko jama kiya aur aawaaz di
Aur kaha ke main tumhaara Rab-e-A'la hoon
To Khuda ne use duniya o aakhirat dono ke azaab ki giraft mein le liya
Is waaqe mein khauf-e-Khuda rakhne waalon ke liye ibrat ka saamaan hai
Kya tumhaari khilqat aasmaan banaane se zyaada mushkil kaam hai ke us ne aasmaan ko banaaya hai
Us ki chhat ko buland kiya aur phir baraabar kar diya hai
Us ki raat ko taareek banaaya hai aur din ki raushni nikaal di hai
Us ke baad zameen ka farsh bichhaaya hai
Us mein se paani aur chaara nikaala hai
Aur pahaadon ko gaad diya hai
Yeh sab tumhaare aur jaanwaron ke liye ek sarmaaya hai
Phir jab badi museebat aa jaaegi
Jis din insaan yaad karega ke us ne kya kiya hai
Aur Jahannam ko dekhne waalon ke liye numaayaan kar diya jaaega
Phir jis ne sarkashi ki hai
Aur zindagaani-e-duniya ko ikhtiyaar kiya hai
Jahannam us ka thikaana hoga
Aur jis ne Rab ki baargaah mein haaziri ka khauf paida kiya hai aur apne nafs ko khwaahishaat se roka hai
To Jannat us ka thikaana aur markaz hai
Paighambar! Log aap se qiyaamat ke baare mein poochhte hain ke us ka thikaana kab hai
Aap us ki yaad ke baare mein kis manzil par hain
Us ke ilm ki intiha aap ke Parwardigar ki taraf hai
Aap to sirf us ka khauf rakhne waalon ko us se daraane waale hain
Goya jab woh log use dekhenge to aisa maaloom hoga jaise ek shaam ya ek subah duniya mein thehre hain
